title: A delegated child whose cleanup failed shows no Stop/retry control in the composer or delegated footer, although the backend accepts a retry Stop on that error state
outcome: An operator can retry a failed or ambiguous child cleanup from the UI: the session composer and the delegated-child footer offer the retry when, and only when, the backend reports the cleanup-retry capability for that session.
acceptance: A delegated child whose cleanup failed shows no Stop/retry control in the composer or delegated footer, although the backend accepts a retry Stop on that error state is done
